Packaging and plastics-linked consumer firms (PDES, INDR) are gaining on input-cost stabilization and export-driven volume recovery, offering durable margin expansion into 2025.
sectors.ai: Buy selective small/mid-cap FMCG names showing volume-price breakouts (PDES, ADES, AGAR) while large caps lag; momentum is broad but fragile, so take profits on 10%+ single-day spikes. Favor water/beverage and packaging sub-sectors for earnings visibility; avoid chasing BTEK without confirmation. Position for a 2-4 week hold as IDX consumer breadth improves, but trim if aggregate signal flips negative.
